readiness.hed: A dry, mild stretch holds over Fredericksburg through Thursday's game between the Texans and Colts, with afternoon highs climbing from near 62 today to near 68 by Thursday and clear, cool nights in between
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this morning. Today stays sunny with a high near 62, then clear skies hold overnight with a low near 33. Wednesday and Thursday both stay sunny and warm up further, with highs near 66 and 68, before clouds build in Thursday night with a low near 38 — a calm, dry run with only a gradual cloud increase at the back end of the forecast.
actions: Light winds and clear skies tonight into Wednesday morning mean frost is likely on car windshields and any exposed plants — a scraper and a cover for sensitive greenery are worth keeping handy.
Overnight lows in the low-to-mid 30s through Wednesday night mean outdoor spigots and hoses are worth draining or covering before bed each night this week.
A dry, sunny run through Thursday is a good window for outdoor church activities, yard work or travel before clouds build in Thursday night.
Morning temperatures near freezing mean coats and gloves at the bus stop, and a few extra minutes to defrost the car, are worth planning for through midweek.
